executive_summary: Independent six-check review of the 27 Nov 2026 09:12:17 ET freeze (candidate a864b56a): the bytes hash to candidate.sha256, canonical(data/current.json) equals the same digest, structural-flags.json is [], publish.py --check reports a valid structure with no flags, and the worktree is clean. Official policy reproduces on the primaries: the Fed held 3-3/4 to 4 percent on 28 Oct by a 10-2 vote with Cook and Hammack preferring +1/4 (federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm) and meets 8-9 Dec with the SEP (fomccalendars.htm); the BoC raised 25bp to 2.50 percent with Bank Rate 2.75 and deposit 2.45, CPI 'about 3 1/2% by the end of the year' and 3% average in 2027 (bankofcanada.ca/2026/10/fad-press-release-2026-10-28/), next announcement 9 Dec 09:45 ET after the 24 Nov 2027-2031 framework renewal at a 2% midpoint of the 1-3% band with total CPI as the focus. Pricing reproduces: Kalshi five-leg mids at 09:26 ET (fifteen minutes after the frozen 09:11:09 stamp) still read 0.035/0.935/0.035/0.005/0.005 for Fed, i.e. 95.5% any-size hike (92.1 exact, 3.4 >25bp) versus the frozen 95.6%, and 0.005/0.815/0.185/0.005/0.005 for BoC, i.e. 80.8% versus the frozen 80.9%; Polymarket prints 96.5/3.6/0.4 Fed and 82.0/17.5/0.1 BoC against the frozen 96/4/0 and 82/18/0, with volumes matching at $65.4M and $394.3k. The economic releases verify on the primaries: BEA October PCE +0.3% m/m, headline +3.8% y/y, core +3.3%; BEA Q3 GDP second estimate +4.3% (advance +3.4) with private-domestic final sales +5.8%; BLS October payrolls +165k, unemployment 4.1%, AHE +0.4%/3.1%, August revised to +186k and September to +60k; StatCan October CPI 3.1% y/y, gasoline +30.9%, CPI-trim 1.8%, median 2.0%; SLOS -6.48 business and -26.27 mortgage against -1.04/+0.64; LFS -4,700 with 6.7% unemployment. The blocking problem is in the BoC driver set: boc-h2 (28 Oct statement plus MPR) and boc-h3 (10 Nov Summary of Governing Council deliberations) are two cards and two weights for the same 28 Oct policy signal, although AGENT.md section 3.4 requires a statement and its minutes to be merged into one card once both publish; the 3+2 hawkish split therefore double-counts the decision and props up the base +5 'lean hike' band. That is a major / must_fix, so the verdict is REVISE; the three minors (a Macklem quote that belongs to the separate 16 Nov Sparks research note, an unlabelled investing.com Reuters copy in fed-h2, and a 1-2bp double count in the Fed implied_rate_after arithmetic) do not block on their own. No structural flags were emitted; no escalation applies because neither of the previous two rounds carried a major on this field.

findings.issue: boc-h2 (28 Oct statement plus MPR) and boc-h3 (10 Nov Summary of Governing Council deliberations) are two separate cards and two separate weights for the same 28 Oct policy signal. AGENT.md section 3.4 requires one card and one weight per policy signal and says to merge a policy statement and its minutes once both publish; keeping a 3-weight statement card and a 2-weight deliberations card double-counts the same decision and inflates the BoC hawkish tally behind the base +5 'lean hike' band.
